ImageDescription.value:
A ham salad lunch at a house and gardens open day at Copped Hall, aka Copt Hall or Copthall, a Grade II listed country house, 1.5 miles (2 km) west from the town of Epping, Essex, England. The house and its ancillary buildings are within the civil parish of Epping Upland, with the larger part of the gardens to the west, in Waltham Abbey.
The present mid-18th-century Georgian hall replaced an earlier Elizabethan hall by Sir Thomas Heneage. It was destroyed by fire in 1917, with it and its gardens suffering further 20th-century destruction and neglect. The property is being restored by The Copped Hall Trust.
